title: galium lucidum var. fontanesianum
intro: Galium lucidum var. fontanesianum, commonly known as Korean gallium, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to alleviate various health conditions such as fever, sore throat, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Korean gallium include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects, making it a potential treatment for wounds, infections, and inflammatory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Korean gallium include iridoid glycosides, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
